latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — enables fast AI-powered video creation from text or footage.

- Create marketing or social videos from text, scripts, or uploaded files (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB).
- Cloud-based rendering at 1080p; returns ready-to-download MP4 files in 1–2 minutes.
- Simple authentication: auto-generates free token for 7-day access with 100 credits.
- Supports credits check, timeline editing, state queries, and exporting videos.
- Handles errors and file type support with clear user feedback.
- Optimized for marketers and content creators aiming to quickly produce social media videos.
